cause_quote: The new guard `if (!params.prepareGitExposure && preflightBaseSha === params.beforeSha)` returned `already-current` before checking whether the installed runtime artifacts were complete.
user_saw: Running `openclaw update` on a Git checkout already at the requested commit failed runtime verification and left the missing artifacts unrepaired.
summary: Git updates now skip rebuilding only when the installed runtime passes artifact verification, and Git status JSON reports artifact readiness and the built version.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #138839 and confirmed that the Git updater ran the build and repaired missing Control UI assets even when the target commit matched HEAD. #138839 added the same-commit shortcut before the build, and #156996 narrowed that shortcut to builds with matching provenance, leaving incomplete runtimes with matching provenance on the same failing path.
